ticket.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
ticket.notes: Student org wants 20 hoodies, size M, asking for a bulk discount.

decision.decision: Approve a maximum 10% bulk discount for this order if all 20 units can be confirmed for fulfillment: $52.20 per hoodie, or $1,044 total. This remains above the $22/unit cost ($604 gross profit across 20 at that price). Do not confirm the quantity or a delivery date now: only 8 size-M hoodies are in stock. Replenishing the 12-unit shortfall would cost an estimated $264, while checking has $160, so no purchase order is proposed; the $104 gap must be resolved before relying on a reprint. Bulldog Print Co has a 5-day lead time and no unpaid-invoice blocker, but that does not overcome the current cash shortfall. The open-ticket check showed no other open tickets competing for stock or cash.
next_steps: Send the draft only after review; ask whether Yale AI Club would accept split fulfillment or alternatives, and explain that the 10% offer applies only if all 20 can be confirmed.
If additional funds become available or another approved funding route is identified, reassess the 12-unit reprint and confirm timing before promising delivery.

drafts.subject: Your hoodie request
drafts.body:
Hi Yale AI Club,

Thanks for reaching out about 20 navy hoodies in size M. We currently have 8 available, so we can’t yet confirm the full quantity or a delivery date. If we can confirm fulfillment of all 20, we can offer a 10% bulk discount: $52.20 per hoodie ($1,044 total).

Would you be open to receiving the available 8 first and the rest later if we’re able to arrange it? Alternatively, we’d be happy to discuss a different quantity or other options that might work for your group. We’ll follow up once we can confirm what’s feasible.

Best,
Campus Customs
